stream.scotty.slicing

Class SlicingWindowOperator<InputType>

  • java.lang.Object
    • stream.scotty.slicing.SlicingWindowOperator<InputType>
  • Type Parameters:
    InputType -
    All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, WindowOperator<InputType>

    public class SlicingWindowOperator<InputType>
extends Object
implements WindowOperator<InputType>
    Implementation of the slicing window operator based on the Scotty technique: Scotty: Efficient AbstractWindow Aggregation for out-of-order Stream Processing: Jonas Traub, Philipp M. Grulich, Alejandro Rodrıguez Cuéllar, Sebastian Breß, Asterios Katsifodimos, Tilmann Rabl, Volker Markl *
